_comment: Preguntas ORIGINALES tipo NIE del capítulo 4.8. No son preguntas reales del examen. Comprueba con tu edición 2027.

questions.scenario: Under s. 66 (exposure), what must A intend?
options: That someone will see his/her genitals and be caused alarm or distress

questions.scenario: A man exposes his genitals in a park intending passers-by to be shocked, but nobody sees. Which is correct?
options: s. 66 – complete; it is the intention that matters

questions.scenario: A man urinates against a wall in the street; he isn't trying to be seen. Is it s. 66?
options: No – no intent that someone sees and is alarmed/distressed

questions.scenario: What is the maximum penalty for exposure?
A sends an unsolicited photo of his genitals by AirDrop to a stranger, intending to humiliate her. Which offence?
options: s. 66A – sending a photograph or film of genitals

questions.scenario: Which intent/purpose satisfies s. 66A?
options: Intent that B sees and is caused alarm, distress or humiliation, or sexual gratification while reckless as to that
explanations: Must also be reckless as to alarm etc.

questions.scenario: For voyeurism under s. 67(1), A must observe B doing a private act for the purpose of…
options: Obtaining sexual gratification, knowing B doesn't consent to being observed for that purpose

questions.scenario: A gym employee drills a hole in the changing-room wall to watch women undress. Before he uses it, he's caught. Which offence?
options: s. 67(4) – constructing/adapting a structure with intent

questions.scenario: Which of these is a 'private act' under s. 68?
options: Using a lavatory in a place reasonably expected to provide privacy
Sunbathing clothed in a garden visible from the street

questions.scenario: B is in her bedroom in her underwear with curtains closed. Is she doing a private act?
options: Yes – reasonable expectation of privacy and covered only with underwear

questions.scenario: A records his partner having sex without her knowledge, intending to watch it later for gratification. Which offence?
explanations: Consent to being recorded is needed.

questions.scenario: A films up a woman's skirt on an escalator to share with friends to humiliate her. Which offence?
options: s. 67A – upskirting (purpose of humiliation is enough)

questions.scenario: Which purposes are covered by s. 67A?
options: Sexual gratification, or humiliating, alarming or distressing B

questions.scenario: Under s. 67A, the genitals or buttocks may be…
After a breakup, A shares an intimate photo of B online without consent. No intent to humiliate is shown. Which is correct (⚠)?
options: Base offence of sharing an intimate image under s. 66B – no specific intent needed
explanations: The base offence has no intent element.

questions.scenario: Does s. 66B cover deepfakes?
options: Yes – images that show or appear to show B in an intimate state

questions.scenario: A threatens to post B's intimate photos unless she gets back with him. Which is correct?
options: Threatening to share an intimate image (s. 66B) – also consider blackmail

questions.scenario: From when did the s. 66B intimate image offences apply (⚠)?
Sexual activity in a public lavatory (s. 71) is…
Does s. 71 apply to a lavatory in a private house?
options: No – a lavatory to which the public or a section of the public has access

questions.scenario: Which section covers sexual penetration of a corpse?
Which section covers intercourse with an animal?
A registered sex offender moves address. Within how many days must he notify police (⚠)?
A man watches through a window as his neighbour undresses in her bedroom, for sexual gratification. Which offence?
options: No offence – he was on his own land

questions.scenario: A installs a hidden camera in an Airbnb bathroom so that he can watch guests for sexual gratification. Which subsection?
What is the maximum penalty for voyeurism (s. 67)?
